statement: Write x_k^{2^k} = n^{3^{O_k}} F_k for a finite Juggler prefix. The proposed survival inequality F_k >= n^{2^k - 3^{O_k}} is equivalent to x_k >= n. The proposed growth law 3^{O_k} >= 2^k on an AboveAnchor prefix is power_bound_word plus x_k >= n, already Lean as aboveAnchor_not_envelope_drop. The weighted floor product is globalDefect. Leftover controls 365, 501, 1517, 6187 stay noncontracting until a formally contracting drop letter. This is not a new global budget and not a halt theorem.
